description_en: The Bhavānīśaṅkara Mandira constructed in theśikharastyle and entirely in stone by a certain Bhavānīśaṅkara Bhāro in the memory of his parents in NS 797 (1676 CE), is located at Yachu Ṭola, Sundhara. It faces west.Originally, statues of Bhavānīśaṅkara (Umāmaheśvara) and Lakṣmīnārāyaṇa were enshrined in the sanctum of the Temple. However, the Statue of Lakṣmīnārāyaṇa is not there anymore and whereabout of that initially consecrated statute is unknown. Upon the completion of the initial construction of the Temple, a fire oblation (yajña) was performed and a golden pinnacle was offered to it. King Śrīnivāsa Malla and his son Yoganarendra Malla were also present on that occasion. Bhavānīśaṅkara Bhāro had endowed a plot of five and a halfropanīs of land and established aguthito operate the Temple and sponsor its anniversary rituals to be held on the 12thof the dark fortnight of Kārtika (cf.C. KāyasthaNS 1135, 56-58). This event has come to an end for several years.The Temple has no priest to carry out the rituals.
description_ne: सुन्धाराको उत्तरतिर रहेको दथु बाहा: (LAL1830) छिर्ने गल्लीनिर यो मन्दिर रहेको छ । ढुङ्गाले बनाइएको यो शिखरकूट मन्दिर पश्चिमाभिमुख रहेको छ । यछु टोलको पश्चिमपट्टि बस्ने भवानीशङ्कर भारोले दिवंगत मातापिताको सम्झनामा नेसं ७९७ (सन् १६७६) मा यो मन्दिरको निर्माण गरेका थिए । मन्दिरभित्र भवानीशङ्कर र लक्ष्मीनारायणको मूर्ति स्थापना गरिएको थियो । मन्दिरको निर्माण सम्पन्न भएको उपलक्ष्यमा अहोरात्र यज्ञ गरी सुनको गजूर चढाइएको थियो ।त्यस अवसरमा राजा श्रीनिवास मल्ल र उनका छोरा योगनरेन्द्र मल्ल पनि उपस्थित भएका थिए । भवानीशङ्कर भारोले मन्दिर सञ्चालन गर्नको लागि साढे पाँच रोपनी खेत गुठी राखिदिएका थिए । त्यस खेतको आम्दानीबाट प्रत्येक वर्ष कार्तिक कृष्ण १२ दिनमा मन्दिरको वर्षवर्द्धन गर्नुपर्ने व्यवस्था मिलाइएको थियो (C. KāyasthaNS 1135, 56-58) ।यो मन्दिरमा कुनै पूजारी नियुक्त गरिएको छैन । प्रत्येक वर्ष कार्तिक कृष्ण १२ का दिनमा गरिने वर्षवर्द्धन पूजा पनि बन्द भइसकेको छ ।
monument_assessment: Slightly damaged (minor damages such as minor cracks, plants, missing stones in plinths)

historical_events.event_name: Initial construction of the Temple and land endowment
historical_events.event_description: Bhavānīśaṇkara Bhār living in west of Yachu Ṭoola built this Temple in the memory of his parents. He had also endowed five and a halfropanīsof land to run the Temple and sponsor its annual rituals.
